observations.identity_status: Name BORE legible on the bow and on the quay banner; OSM name=Bore.

observed.hull: beige/khaki hull to the sheer line, raked stem with the name on the bow
observed.superstructure: white tiers with rows of rectangular windows, bridge forward
observed.funnels: two oval funnels: black top, ochre, blue-white-blue bands with a white vertical stripe and a B, ochre base
observed.masts: tan foremast and mainmast; strings of lights from the stem over both mast heads to the stern
observed.lifeboats: orange lifeboats on davits along the aft upper deck

observations.method: patch medians on the overcast reference, white balance gain 1.14 from the superstructure white (186-196 to 217); band fractions measured on the left funnel; stem rake 0.5 m per metre of freeboard from the bow silhouette, corrected for the 38 degree view angle
observations.use: Paint, band fractions and porthole rows only; sizes and positions stay with the lidar survey.
